verdict.rationale: The README says llama.cpp ships custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA GPUs, supports AMD GPUs via HIP and Moore Threads GPUs via MUSA, and uses Metal on Apple silicon, with CPU+GPU hybrid offload. Community users confirm CUDA acceleration works in practice. One user saw only about a 2x speedup on a 4090, which is a performance caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation for each backend beyond README bullets, and hands-on corroboration for AMD/HIP or MUSA.
